segments.text: The Mechanics of Kundalini, Drishti, and the Astral World
Introduction: The Power of the Guru and Drishti (Divine Vision) (0:00 - 24:00)

Greetings to everyone. Today, we are discussing the fundamental elements of the astral world. Everything shared here comes directly from the grace and teachings of the Guru, Lord Hanuman. I also bow to Parikshit Bhaiya, a divine manifestation seated at Aas hayein, who carries the miraculous boon of instantly awakening a person's Drishti (Divine Vision/Third Eye) and exposing the truth of the astral realm.

People often misunderstand Drishti . Drishti is just a tool. The real power behind it is Shakti (Energy). Divine Grace is a blessing, but Shakti — specifically Siddhi — is the energy produced by a human being through repetitive spiritual practice (like chanting). If you want to see accurately in the astral world, your energy must be greater than the energy of whatever you are looking at. Otherwise, dark entities can mani pulate your vision. To protect our practitioners, our Guru has established a massive "Base Level" of energy at Aashayein. When you connect with this base through your chanting, you gain an immense energetic shield, allowing your Drishti to see the unmanipulated truth without needing decades of personal penance.
The 70% Rule: What is Kundalini Shakti? (24:00 - 30:00)

Today's core topic is Kundalini Shakti . Kundalini dictates 70% of your life’s destiny. Past - life karma and previous Siddhis (powers) make up about 15%. Your personal efforts fill in the rest. What about Astrology and Planets? Planets actually only control 3% of your life. However, if an ordinary person does absolutely zero spiritual practice, has no past -life powers, and puts in no effort, that 3% takes over and rules 100% of their life.
By awakening your Kundalini , you take 70% of your destiny directly into your own hands.
The Mechanics of Prayer and Fake Awakenings (30:00 - 37:30)

There are many myths about Kundalini . People think it's just about opening 33 chakras. In reality, Kundalini is directly proportional to Prarthana Shakti (The Power of Prayer). When you pray deeply, an energy rises from your root chakra (Muladhara ) and travels upward through different dimensions. The higher your Kundalini can reach into these dimensions, the more powerful your prayers become, because you can summon higher divine forces.

Beware of fake awakenings. You may see videos of gurus touching someone, and the person starts violently shaking or dancing. What actually happens is that the guru forces a massive, unnatural amount of energy through the person's chakras. This blows the ch akras wide open, creating a massive empty passage. But because the person didn't build that energy themselves, the energy leaves, leaving the passage dangerously open. The person becomes hyper -sensitive, emotionally unstable, and highly vulnerable. Negativ e entities (like Prets or black magic) love to come and sit directly on this open, empty Kundalini passage. Once a
negative entity sits there, your prayers can no longer travel upward, and your spiritual connection is severed.
Dimensional Ascent and Externalizing the Kundalini (37:30 - 47:30)

True Kundalini awakening is a dimensional journey. Your energy rises, crosses a dimension, and drops back to zero. The physical/astral body has 7 chakras, but the dimensions above have 32, then 64, 108, and so on. Your energy will rise and fall millions of times.

A true shift happens around the 140 to 150 millionth dimension. Here, the energy stops dropping back to zero. It establishes a new, higher "base." As you continue your spiritual chanting (Japa ), this energy eventually shifts to sit entirely outside of your physical body, usually hovering over a shoulder. It takes on a massive, physical form that matches the deity of the mantra you are chanting.

When your Kundalini externalizes, it becomes your ultimate protector. It takes all spiritual, tantric, and energetic attacks upon itself so your physical body feels zero pain. It also reads your mind and acts on your thoughts instantly.
The Kedarnath Incident: The True Power of Kundalini (47:30 - 54:00)

To explain how powerful this is, years ago, my vision opened and I saw two Aghoris meditating in Kedarnath. Behind them stood a massive, towering entity, 2 kilometers tall. I thought it was their Guru protecting them. I tried to look closer, but negative e ntities noticed me and attacked me. I wondered why my Guru didn't protect me the way that towering Guru protected the Aghoris.

My Guru, Lord Hanuman, later revealed to me: That was not their Guru. That was their own Kundalini Shakti. When your Kundalini is that massive, it protects you so fiercely that you do not even need to call upon deities or messengers. It becomes an impenetrable shield.
Becoming a Dev Putra (Son of God) and Universal Authority (54:00 - 1:27:50)

If a person's Kundalini reaches 1.5 million kilometers in size, they are considered a Dev Putra (Son of God). At this scale, their energy reaches the root chakra of the Gods themselves, and they begin absorbing divine elements while living in a human body.
How do you achieve this? Through Mantra Japa (Chanting).

• The Mantra: Clears the path and creates the road upward. • The Doots (Messengers): Follow the mantra and grant you the passage to travel. • The Kundalini: Acts as the brain and engine that travels upward.

When your Kundalini travels through enough dimensions, you gain Universal Authority/Validation . This means when you speak a command, the universe obeys it because your energy has been validated across dimensions. Furthermore, participating in Havan (Fire Rituals) accelerates this. Havan does not create energy; it establishes a relationship and validation between you and multiple dimensions.

Surrender to the mantra, trust your Guru, and practice relentlessly. You are here listening to this because of your past karma, and it is time to awaken what is yours. II. Comprehensive Knowledge Article: The Mechanics of Kundalini, Dimensions, and Astral Authority

The spiritual universe operates on precise, unbreakable mechanics. While modern spiritual communities often reduce Kundalini awakening to a physical sensation or a quick weekend workshop, the truth of the astral realm is vastly more complex. Based on the deep astral research and teachings provided at Aashayein, here is a detailed breakdown of how Kundalini Shakti , Drishti , and Universal Authority actually function. 1. Drishti (Divine Vision) and the Concept of the "Base Level"
Drishti (the Third Eye) is frequently misunderstood as the ultimate spiritual goal. In reality, Drishti is merely a tool — a lens. The entity looking through the lens requires Shakti (Energy/Siddhi).

In the astral world, if you attempt to look at an entity or a person whose energetic frequency is higher than yours, they can manipulate your vision. You will see what they want you to see, not the truth. To combat this, a true Guru provides a Base Level of energy. By connecting to a spiritually charged lineage or space (like Aashayein), practitioners gain temporary access to a massive reservoir of energy. This protective shield ensures their Drishti remains accurate, un -manipulated, and protected from astral deception. 2. The 70% Destiny Rule
How much of your life is predetermined? The astral sciences break human destiny down into clear percentages:

• 70% is controlled by your Kundalini Shakti. • 15% is controlled by Prarabdha (Past -life karma and stored Siddhis). • 12% is shaped by your current human effort. • 3% is controlled by the Planets (Astrology).

Most people believe astrology dictates their entire life. This is only true for the spiritually stagnant. If a person does zero spiritual practice and puts in zero effort, that 3% planetary influence expands to control 100% of their life. However, by awake ning the Kundalini , a practitioner reclaims 70% of their destiny, effectively neutralizing negative planetary impacts.
3. Prarthana Shakti (The Power of Prayer) and Fake Awakenings

Kundalini Shakti is the exact same energy as Prarthana Shakti (The Power of Prayer). When a person prays, an energetic wave travels from the Muladhara (Root Chakra) upward. The dimension this energy can reach dictates how powerful the prayer is.

The Danger of Fake Awakenings: Many "gurus" claim to awaken Kundalini via physical touch, causing the receiver to shake or vibrate violently. This is highly dangerous. The guru is forcing a massive, unnatural volume of energy through the person's energetic passage, blowing the chakras open. Because the person did not generat e this energy themselves, it eventually dissipates, leaving behind a massive, empty energetic highway.

• The Result: The person becomes hyper -sensitive, easily angered, and emotionally volatile. Worse, this open passage invites free -roaming negative entities (like Prets or Black Magic). The entity will sit comfortably on this open passage, completely blocking the person's prayers from ever reaching the divine. 4. Dimensional Ascent and the External Kundalini
True awakening requires moving through dimensions. The first dimension contains 14 chakras (7 physical, 7 astral). The second contains 32, the next 64, then 108, scaling infinitely.

As a practitioner chants (Japa ), their Kundalini rises, clears a dimension, and drops back to a zero state. This happens millions of times. However, around the 140 to 150 millionth dimension , a permanent shift occurs. The energy stops returning to zero and establishes a new, elevated base outside the physical body.

The External Body: Eventually, the Kundalini shifts to hover outside the physical body (often over the shoulder). It grows into a massive, independent entity that takes on the form of the deity the practitioner is chanting to.

• Absolute Protection: This external Kundalini takes the brunt of all tantric, magical, or energetic attacks. The physical body feels nothing. • Mind -Reading Executor: The external Kundalini reads the practitioner's subconscious. If the practitioner feels threatened, the Kundalini will aggressively attack the threat without hesitation. (This was witnessed in Kedarnath, where Aghoris were protected by their own towering, 2 -kilometer -tall Kundalini forces). 5. Dev Putra (Son of God) and Universal Validation

The expansion of Kundalini has no limit. When a practitioner's Kundalini reaches 1.5 million kilometers in length, they achieve the title of Dev Putra (Son of God). At this magnitude, their energy extends directly into the root chakra of the Gods, allowing them to absorb divine characteristics while still in a mortal body.
How to Achieve This: Mantra, Doots, and Havan

1. The Mantra: Acts as the plow, breaking ground and clearing the path upward. 2. The Doots (Messengers): Follow the mantra, providing the clearance and authority for the practitioner's subtle body to travel. 3. Havan (Fire Ritual): Havan does not create energy; it creates Relationships . It acts as a cosmic networking tool, establishing validation for the practitioner across multiple dimensions.

When a practitioner's energy reaches enough dimensions, they receive Universal Authority . At this stage, the universe recognizes their frequency. Whatever words they speak or commands they give are immediately executed by the surrounding energies. This is the ultimate peak of spiritual manifestation. III.
